description.p: A Markdown editor and viewer for GNOME, modelled on GNOME Text Editor, with a live preview.

ul.li: Tabs, find and replace, outline, spell checking, file change detection
GitHub alerts, task lists, footnotes, tables, front matter
Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, syntax highlighting, image carousels
Synchronized scrolling, HTML export and printing
Flatpak bundle: self-contained on the GNOME 51 runtime, with spell checking.
AppImage: small; runs on GNOME 49 or newer desktops using the system libraries.
Spell checking is optional when libspelling is not installed.

description.p: Large documents edit and scroll smoothly; changelog sections are folded by default.
